fields.acceptance: Unit tests in internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestRequestExposedWorkflows) cover: plan auto with rhiza.daemon.permissionMode bypassPermissions flags plan only; plan, accept and ship auto flags plan and ship-change; plan and ship auto with rhiza.autonomy.accept owner flags plan only; plan owner with ship auto under a bypass daemon mode flags plan, not ship-change; a step permission_mode acceptEdits under a bypass daemon mode is not flagged and a step permission_mode bypassPermissions with no daemon mode is; arbiter steps are counted; ship-change is flagged through an included workflow's role alone (a leaves-step builder or verifier, or a checks-step check, critic or fixer, with permission_mode bypassPermissions and no daemon mode), naming that step and role; each entry names the workflow, its trigger (request or ready) and the bypassing steps; and, when dispatch.toml support exists, a workflow named by a [request] or [ready] rule is flagged
fields.statement: One function in internal/api lists the workflows the daemon would run from a queued request with no person in between, each with its trigger and the steps and roles whose effective mode the session's adapter reports as a bypass mode, counting every agent session the workflow starts, following its included workflows: agent and arbiter steps, a leaves step's builder and verifier, and a checks step's checks, critic, fixer and verifier, each with its own permission_mode, else the run's (the repo's rhiza.daemon.permissionMode): the request workflow (plan) whatever rhiza.autonomy.plan says, milestone requests included (an interactive plan run is no gate: its agents read the request text before the owner joins), and the ready workflow (ship-change) when rhiza.autonomy.plan, rhiza.autonomy.accept and rhiza.autonomy.ship are all auto (with accept owner a person accepts the planned change set before it is ready); where .rhiza/dispatch.toml exists in the code it builds on (Workflow dispatch landed first), it reads every [request] and [ready] rule plus the built-in defaults instead of the fixed picks
